notes.title: V0.0.10-beta1 update
notes.notes:
V0.0.10-beta1 

 I haven't had time to update the game for a while, please forgive me.


 Virtual Coin Gameplay (Test)


 Added basic computer accessory system (not installed)


 Added NPCs to some stores


 Now you can charge your Smart A10 phone


 New Computer System (Test)


 New buildings: Yinhe Police Station, Hong Kong East Supermarket (no content yet)


 Fixed text errors


 Fixed an issue with unlimited swipes on one of the hotel walls


 Fixed an issue where bars could buy unlimited fish fries


 New job in restaurants: Waiters


 Fixed an issue where bank note cutters and security guards could continue to work after completion


 Removed Scratch option to scratch 100 pieces (to prevent too many pieces from getting stuck)


 Fixed an issue with wrong items in bank deposits and withdrawals


 Reworked the bank deposits and withdrawals function. You can now customize the amount of deposits and withdrawals


 Removed Halloween activities and merged Halloween recipes into the main recipe


 The name entry system has been improved. The problem with undetermined keys is no longer stuck


 Fixed an issue where the press machine could not stand by


 Fixed issue where Washing could stack infinitely cleanly (slightly reduced the amount of regeneration)


 Add new classes in department stores and bars


 Added 3 new recipes and 2 new ingredients


 Fixed several issues where it was impossible to determine the current status of a character

notes.title: V0.0.9-beta3 update
notes.notes:
V0.0.9-beta2 

Note that the content of the current version may not be perfect due to some problems encountered by developers in real life. A new version will be updated as soon as possible.


 Change


 1. Now you can buy a house (lump-sum payment and installments)


 2. Complete optional contents of some buildings in Yinhe City


 3. Pet system improvement


 4.2014 Script plot and task expansion


 5. New map: Nanhe Street


 6. New buildings on the general map: pet shops, waste recycling stations, industrial, agricultural and commercial houses, breeding greenhouses, and some uninstalled buildings


 7. The event of sister's arrival and part of the plot have been added (the social button will be available after sister's arrival, which is still not perfect at present)


 8. Now you can have more interaction with Qiu Li


 9. TV program available on 15th of each month: "Half tour of Exotic Cuisine" for special recipes (currently only 1 and not properly installed)


 10. Added a new job on site - cement worker (afternoon job only)


 11. Now you can go through the garbage cans for the waste products


 12. New Mercantilist Act event (only available in the second month of the 2014 script - will receive a 50% discount of the housing price until October 2014 and a permanent start-up support fund)


 Fix


 1. Fix a number of known issues in the previous release


 2. Now the loan amount will be changed to another form (cannot be used to buy stocks, lottery tickets, cannot be used to repay the medical expenses of the family drama)


 3. Detail optimization

notes.title: V0.0.8-beta1 update
notes.notes:
V0.0.8-beta1   Note: novice teaching and stock system is not available for the time being   Change 
 added a new family relationship for the family transformation script. Now you can set the name of the player's sister after selecting the script (incomplete) 

 at the beginning, you can choose not to rent a house

 new buildings in Yinhe City: Yinhe Hotel (new hotel accommodation function)

 now you can get parts from the old cars in the old garage. A used car can be disassembled many times

 add newsstand function and newspaper

 now you can choose to sleep on a bench on the street or rest to reduce fatigue

 new attribute concept: fatigue value (not fully introduced)

 Note: This is a reverse value. The initial fatigue value is 0. The larger the value, the more fatigue. Only rest or sleep can reduce fatigue

  Fix 

 revised script setting text


 boiling water will cool faster now


 fixed the problem that stocks can be sold indefinitely


 improves the physical strength of the characters in the family drama and reduces the thirst speed of all characters


 repaired the relevant problems of used cars in the old garage


 improved the recovery value of some foods and drinks


 now pancakes  are also considered junk food


 fixed the problem that the initial random funds of the characters in the student era script could not be obtained


 sleeping in bed no longer reduces health


 now you can choose to rent back when you call boss Wang


 Now the initial difficulty selection will affect the hotel's accommodation price


 detail optimization

notes.title: V0.0.7-Beta1 Update
notes.notes: First of all, I'm sorry to all the players who have been waiting for a long time. Now the developers have returned to development normally. We hope to complete this game as much as possible and develop more interesting new works. Thank you for your support and feedback. The following is the main content of this update   V0.0.7-beta1     Note: 2014 script is for college students with family changes - 2016 script is for young girls who moved to Yinhe city to live      change    Revision of city map     New vehicles: small electric donkey    Now, 2016 script characters will bring their own bank cards and add new contacts (a few new stories)     New part-time job in Yinhe restaurant: Dishwasher     Take out function of mobile phone     New map: Dongfang port     Add new stocks: Beiqi interactive entertainment media Co., Ltd., creative action network     Now Nanjie district will be open by default in the 2016 script     Fix    Fixed the inability to buy a pet house in the 2014 script    Fixed the problem of abnormal judgment of mobile phone contact     Adjusted the maximum income of brick handling to 150 gold coins    Other details optimization
